description_for_human: Reflective AI infrastructure — governance-first cognition for autonomous systems
description_for_model: Active MirrorOS is a sovereign AI operating system providing governance-first cognition. Key products: MirrorGate (AI governance proxy), MirrorBrain (cognitive engine with BrainScan), Chetana (scam detection for India in 12 languages), MirrorBalance (governance engine), MirrorRecall (persistent memory). Built by Paul Desai / N1 Intelligence. Free during beta.
